correctness.rationale: Reconstructed four-term Möbius identity, telescoping positive factor, uniqueness and exact equality case of triangle inequality, derivative nonzero at all boundary roots, substitution multiplicities, and asymptotic through \(u=-(q-1)\log\rho\) with bounds \(\log q/p\le u\le\log q\). The expansion gives \(u=W((q-1)/(p-1))+O_p(\log q/q)\), hence \(1-\rho=W((q-1)/(p-1))/(q-1)+O_p((\log q)^2/q^2)\). Replayed standalone checker successfully for 36 exact sparse identities and 9 asymptotic cases. Finite checks do not replace the proof.
